proposal.reason: Main change is adding TROCE as a bundled GIN backend/plugin (new ext-gin/troce host+device implementation, GIN type/API wiring, plugin discovery, and GIN signal semantics). Add network because the PR also makes independently substantive IB transport/proxy changes (TROCE provider detection, QP inline behavior, and SEND_WITH_INV-based signal-set handling in net_ib paths) that affect shared network backend behavior beyond mechanical caller edits.
